details: Bitcoin has struggled to sustain a breakout above the $64,000-$64,500 resistance level, despite moderate U.S. CPI data easing rate hike expectations. The cryptocurrency remains in a consolidation phase, influenced by weak trading volume and renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, indicating strong overhead resistance in the short term.
title: Bitcoin Fails to Break $64K Resistance Despite Moderate US CPI Data

details: Ethereum has stabilized above $1,900 following a period of bearish trading earlier in the year, leading to a more optimistic outlook among analysts. Maintaining this support level is considered crucial for a potential recovery towards the $2,000 mark in the short term, despite slow momentum over recent months.
title: Ethereum Consolidates Above $1,900, Analysts See Potential for $2,000 Recovery

details: The White House is set to host crypto and prediction market executives on August 19, coinciding with the CFTC's Innovation Advisory Committee meeting on August 20. Discussions will focus on crypto assets, AI, and prediction market rules, amid increasing legal challenges against prediction platforms in multiple U.S. states.
title: US Regulators to Discuss Crypto and Prediction Market Regulation

details: Stablecoin issuer Tether has completed an independent audit of its 2025 reserves with KPMG, receiving an unqualified opinion. This development is seen as a significant step towards enhancing transparency and credibility for USDT within the broader cryptocurrency market.
title: Tether Successfully Completes Independent Audit of Reserves with KPMG

details: ShipMonk, a third-party shipping provider for hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor, has experienced a data breach. This incident has led to the exposure of order information for approximately 13,689 Trezor customers, raising privacy and security concerns for those affected.
title: Trezor Shipping Provider Suffers Data Breach, Exposing Customer Order Info

details: The Harmony (ONE) blockchain has suffered a significant security attack, resulting in the unauthorized minting of approximately 4 billion tokens. Around 2.8 billion of these compromised tokens were subsequently transferred to trading platforms, causing Harmony's native token, ONE, to drop by 40% intraday. Cross-chain bridge services have been suspended as a result.
title: Harmony (ONE) Hit by Major Security Attack, Cross-Chain Bridge Halted

details: Hyperliquid (HYPE) has shown notable gains, contrasting with a broader market downturn. This positive performance is linked to reports of a potential expansion of its perpetual futures market into the United States, attracting significant interest from traders.
title: Hyperliquid (HYPE) Defies Market Downturn on US Expansion Reports
